name: keco
description: Build Keco project data, import local images, and develop evaluated Godot gameplay slices.

interface.shortDescription: Build Keco tables, import images, and develop Godot slices.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Keco and use guided workflows to build verified project tables, import local image assets, or implement and evaluate bounded Godot gameplay slices from Keco designs.
defaultPrompt: Build Keco tables from a project design document.
Turn my combat specification into related Keco tables.
Preview a Keco table plan from an existing project document.
Import my local image directory into a verified Keco asset table.
Implement the next Godot gameplay slice from my Keco project and evaluate it.
Read a Keco project document, plan its development ideas as ordered Godot slices, and execute them.
Generate a top-down PixelLab tileset and map-object pack for my Godot scene.
